desc:
🌟 Welcome to Steal A Star!

  🎁 CODES:
  WELCOME - 200K Speed + 30 min x2 Money
  GOO - 30 min x2 Money + 30 min Speed + 10 Cosmic Spins
  GOFAST - $1.5M + 15 min x2 Money + 15 min Speed + 5 Spins
  GOFASTER - 30 min Speed + 5 Cosmic Spins
  SPOOKY - 15 min x2 Money + 10 Cosmic Spins
  WHALESURF - 10 Cosmic Spins
  105LIKE - 10 Cosmic Spins
  LIKE80 - 10 Cosmic Spins
  ADMINABUSE2 - 5 Cosmic Spins
  FREE5 - 5 Cosmic Spins

  ✨ ALSO NEW:
  👑 Leaderboards show the TOP 50 – walk up and scroll!
  💎 Secrets from the 4 new zones can now fuse into DIVINES
  ⚙️ Laggy? Settings → BASE STARS → MINE for more FPS

  How to Play:
  ⭐ Run down the Star Run and grab a star
  🏃 Bring it home before the aliens catch you
  🏠 Place stars in your base to earn cash
  👟 Train on your treadmill to gain Speed
  ⬆️ Upgrade to reach farther zones
  🛡️ Protect your stars—and steal someone else's!
